Official Tencent WeChat OpenSDK for HarmonyOS - supports WeChat share, favourites and payment, matching the Android opensdk surface.

ohpm_mappings.description: alipay standard cashier sdk for ohos
ohpm_mappings.note: Official Alipay cashier SDK - H5 payment, native app payment, H5-to-native handover and standalone signing. NOTE: minSdkVersion 13. The bundled com.alipay.apmobilesecuritysdk / tscenter device-fingerprint internals have no separate package and are left unmapped.

ohpm_mappings.description: lottie是一个适用于OpenHarmony的动画库，它可以使用Bodymovin解析以json格式导出的Adobe After Effects动画，并在移动设备上进行本地渲染
ohpm_mappings.note: Direct port - parses Adobe After Effects animations exported as JSON via Bodymovin and renders them on device. NOTE: the upstream README now recommends @ohos/lottie-turbo (popularity 9473) for new projects - declarative API, parallel loading, in-memory caching and sub-thread rendering for a ~30% performance gain. @ohos/lottie is kept here as the 1:1 migration target.

ohpm_mappings.description: Implementation of ImageView for ohos that supports zooming, by various touch gestures.
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port maintained under openharmony-sig: zoom, pan and rotate on an image view. Ranked below @rv/image-preview (popularity 1300) on popularity but chosen on function - that package is a Swiper-based lightbox gallery, not a zoomable ImageView.

ohpm_mappings.description: Highly configurable, easily extendable deep zoom view for displaying huge images without loss of detail. Perfect for photo galleries, maps, building plans etc
ohpm_mappings.note: Name-for-name port maintained under openharmony-sig: tiled deep-zoom rendering of very large images without loss of detail.

ohpm_mappings.category: Storage and Database > Storage > Key-Value Storage
ohpm_mappings.description: The official OpenHarmony package of MMKV. An efficient, small mobile key-value storage framework developed by WeChat.
ohpm_mappings.note: Official Tencent MMKV port (upstream repo github.com/Tencent/MMKV). NOTE: native @kit.ArkData preferences also covers key-value storage and android.content.SharedPreferences -> @kit.ArkData is existing precedent; MMKV is the mmap-based option for performance-critical cases, so this is the migrator's choice rather than a forced dependency.
